item.title: PM Narendra Modi To Visit Ajmer on February 28, Launch Development Projects Worth INR 23,500 Crore
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Ajmer on February 28 to launch projects worth INR 23,500 crore and distribute 21,000 appointment letters via ‘Rozgar Utsav’.
